sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: US interest-rate sensitivity remains the dominant near-term catalyst for solar/energy-storage equities, with RUN and ENPH leveraged to residential demand recovering as financing costs ease.
Indonesia's renewables lag is structural—PLN's monopoly procurement and below-cost tariffs cap IPP returns, making policy reform, not technology, the binding constraint for durable growth.
Grid infrastructure and resilience spending (KEEN, NRG) is a multi-year, policy-backed driver independent of commodity prices, outpacing pure generation plays in risk-adjusted returns.
sectors.ai: Buy selective US-listed solar/energy storage names (RUN, SEDG, ENPH) on the US rate-cut tailwind, but stay underweight Indonesian renewables until clarity on PLN's procurement and tariff reform. ARKO's +9.6% spike is idiosyncratic—take profits. Rotate into KEEN for US grid-hardening exposure; avoid chasing LAPD.

sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG
themes: Rupiah stability and falling imported input costs are structurally boosting margins for FMCG players with local sourcing, sustaining earnings upgrades into H2.
Rising middle-class disposable income in tier-2/3 cities is driving volume growth for affordable packaged foods and beverages, favoring names with wide distribution networks.
Digitalization of rural retail and direct-to-consumer channels is lowering distribution costs and accelerating SKU penetration, creating durable competitive advantages for agile consumer companies.
sectors.ai: Buy dips in mid-cap consumer names with strong earnings momentum (EL, BEEF, IATA) as US strength and IDX lag create catch-up potential; rotate out of laggards into high-beta FMCG plays, but trim on any 10%+ spike to lock gains given normal signal and weak ID macro.
